clips.title: The story
paras: At Grommash Hold, Zor Lonetree studies the Horde’s concerns beyond Durotar. His knowledge of Alliance politics helps the court judge foreign affairs across Kalimdor.

Zor Lonetree watches beyond Durotar from Grommash Hold. A shrewd advisor to the Horde’s high leadership, he has an unusually keen understanding of human and Alliance politics. When foreign curiosities reach Orgrimmar, he studies them; when trouble stirs among the land’s spirits, he directs travelers toward it. He has examined noble jewelry recovered from human settlements and followed disturbances among the spirits of the Stonetalon Mountains, keeping the warchief’s court informed on both political and spiritual matters.
